mode: Global KOs — sum of all regions
precision: Complete official Season 2 Global top 100 in each mode, captured October 28, 2026. Scores and regional values preserve the English game display; standings can change after capture.

boards.label: KOs
boards.rule: Adds up the best KO run in each of the four regions, on any difficulty. Higher is better.
